title: Research Report Summarisation and Data Extraction
summary: Extract ratings, targets, estimates and guidance from broker research and company filings, with cited summaries and revision alerts for your analysts' internal use.

seo.title: Research Report Summarisation and Extraction | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that reads broker research, results filings and call transcripts, extracts estimates and guidance with citations, and alerts analysts to revisions.

problem.intro: During results season, a buy-side team receives broker updates, exchange filings, investor presentations and earnings call transcripts for every company it covers, often within the same few days. Analysts need the numbers and the changes, such as revised estimates, new guidance and rating moves, not another stack of PDFs.

pain_points.title: Estimates live inside PDFs
pain_points.detail: Target prices, ratings and forward estimates sit in tables in each broker's format, and someone has to key them into a tracking sheet.

pain_points.title: Changes are what matter
pain_points.detail: Spotting that a broker cut its estimates or that management softened guidance means comparing with the previous report by hand.

pain_points.title: Generic summaries are not trusted
pain_points.detail: Summaries without page references cannot be checked quickly, so analysts reread the source anyway.

pain_points.title: Licensing and information barriers
pain_points.detail: Broker research is licensed to named users, and some documents must stay within restricted groups.

solution.overview: We build a research extraction pipeline for your internal research process. It collects broker reports from your research inbox and filings from the exchanges, parses text and tables, and extracts ratings, target prices, estimates, key financials and management guidance into a structured table per company and broker. Each extracted value is checked against the source table, and each summary statement cites its page. The pipeline compares every report with the previous one from the same source and raises alerts on revisions. Analysts can query the archive and get cited answers, with access respecting research licences and restricted groups. Investment views remain with your analysts.
capabilities: Collects broker reports from the research inbox, and results filings, transcripts and presentations from exchange and company sources
Extracts ratings, target prices, forward estimates and key financial tables into a structured dataset
Writes short summaries in which every statement cites its page
Compares each report with the previous one from the same broker and flags revisions
Answers analyst questions across the archive with citations, or says the answer was not found
Applies entitlement-aware access for licensed research and restricted document groups

workflow.title: Collect reports and filings
workflow.detail: Broker research, filings, transcripts and presentations are gathered and tagged by company, source and date.

workflow.title: Parse text and tables
workflow.detail: Documents are parsed with layout preserved, including tables and chart labels.

workflow.title: Extract and compare
workflow.detail: Ratings, targets, estimates and guidance are extracted and compared with the previous report from the same source.

workflow.title: Validate numbers and citations
workflow.detail: Each value is checked against its source cell; uncertain values and citations go to the research data team.

workflow.title: Summarise and alert
workflow.detail: Cited summaries and revision alerts are published to the research database and analyst channels.

workflow.title: Query the archive
workflow.detail: Analysts ask questions across the corpus and get answers with page references.

faqs.q: How do you stop it making up numbers?
faqs.a: Every extracted number is checked against the table cell it came from, and values that cannot be matched are flagged instead of published. Summaries must cite a page for each statement.

faqs.q: Can it read tables and charts?
faqs.a: Tables, yes, including multi-page and footnoted ones. For charts it reads titles, axis labels and data labels where present, but it does not estimate values from bar heights.

faqs.q: Will it give buy or sell calls?
faqs.a: No. It extracts what brokers and companies have said and highlights changes. Investment views remain with your analysts and fund managers.

faqs.q: How is broker research licensing handled?
faqs.a: Access to each document follows the entitlements you hold, so a report licensed to named users is only visible to them, including in search and question answering.
